capabilities: Sync Markdown notes with a Git repository over Smart HTTP
Store and sync attachments in an S3-compatible bucket with SHA-256 verification
Resolve sync conflicts in a built-in three-way editor
View team dashboards, commit history, and per-file authors
Share selected community plugins and their settings across the team
extras: README states the plugin was fully developed by AI and the listing has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. The shared configuration string carries Git and S3 credentials unencrypted and must be sent over a private channel. The remote-wipe command is a destructive test-only function. Supports desktop and mobile, requires Obsidian 1.12.3+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for a small team to share a vault using their own Git repository and object storage, including conflict handling, per-file authorship, and shared plugin setup.

requires.name: Git Smart HTTP repository with Basic Auth
Git username and shared team credentials

summary: Team knowledge base sync plugin that syncs Markdown notes over Git and attachments over S3-compatible storage, with conflict resolution, history, and shared plugin configuration.
